Predicates:
Appropriate(x) ::: x is appropriate for people of all ages.
Guidance(x) ::: children can watch x without guidance from parents.
Excessive(x) ::: x contains excessive erotic and violent content.
RatedGA(x) ::: x is rated General Audience.
FamilyFriendly(x) ::: x is a family-friendly animated film.
Frozen(x) ::: x is a film in the Frozen series.
Film(x) ::: x is a film.
Premises:
∀x (Appropriate(x) → Guidance(x)) ::: If a film is appropriate for people of all ages, then children can watch it without guidance from parents.
∀x (Excessive(x) → ¬Guidance(x)) ::: If a film contains excessive erotic and violent content, children cannot watch it without guidance from their parents.
∀x (RatedGA(x) → Appropriate(x)) ::: If a film is rated General Audience, then it is appropriate for people of all ages.
∀x (FamilyFriendly(x) → RatedGA(x)) ::: All family-friendly animated films are rated General Audience.
∀x (Frozen(x) → FamilyFriendly(x)) ::: All movies in the Frozen series are family-friendly animated films.
Film(hachi) ::: 'Hachi: A Dog's Tale' is a film.
(FamilyFriendly(hachi) ∨ Appropriate(hachi)) ::: 'Hachi: A Dog's Tale' is either a family-friendly animated film or is appropriate for people of all ages.
Conclusion:
(Excessive(hachi) ∧ Frozen(hachi)) ⊕ ¬(Excessive(hachi) ∨ Frozen(hachi)) ::: 'Hachi: A Dog's Tale' either contains excessive erotic and violent content and is a film in the 'Frozen' series, or it neither contains excessive erotic and violent content nor is a film in the 'Frozen' series.
